title: Empirical Bayes for compound adaptive experiments
abstract: arXiv:2609.17158v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We investigate Empirical Bayes (EB) methods in the context of compound adaptive experiments, where the arm distribution in each experiment follows a normal distribution with an unknown mean that we seek to estimate. There are two main EB strategies: $g$-modeling, which estimates the prior by maximizing the marginal likelihood, and $f$-modeling, which derives posterior means directly from the empirical distribution of the observations. We show that $g$-modeling continues to be a valid EB procedure even when it incorrectly assumes that data are collected exogenously; its validity does not depend on the particular sampling algorithm or on whether sample sizes are endogenous. In practice, one can apply standard $g$-modeling techniques by acting as though the data were exogenously sampled. We extend regret guarantees from exogenous sampling to adaptively generated data. translated_title: 复合自适应实验的经验贝叶斯方法
translated_abstract: 我们研究了复合自适应实验背景下的经验贝叶斯（EB）方法，其中每个实验中的各臂分布服从正态分布，其均值未知且有待我们估计。存在两种主要的EB策略：g建模，通过最大化边际似然来估计先验分布；以及f建模，直接从观测值的经验分布推导后验均值。我们证明，即使g建模错误地假设数据是外生收集的，它仍然是一种有效的EB程序；其有效性不依赖于特定的采样算法，也不依赖于样本量是否为内生决定。在实践中，人们只需将数据视为外生采样，即可应用标准的g建模技术。我们还将遗憾保证从外生采样情形扩展到了自适应生成的数据。相比之下，天真地应用基于边际分布的Tweedie公式则……
tldr: 该论文证明经验贝叶斯g建模方法在复合自适应实验中即使错误假设数据为外生采样依然有效，其有效性不依赖于采样算法或样本量的内生性，从而将遗憾保证从外生采样扩展到了自适应生成的数据。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that empirical Bayes g-modeling remains a valid procedure in compound adaptive experiments even when it incorrectly assumes exogenous data collection, with its validity independent of the sampling algorithm or endogenous sample sizes, thereby extending regret guarantees from exogenous sampling to adaptively generated data.
